$comment: Phase-6 introduces Biome as the JS linter, but the existing mc-bot
sources predate Biome's defaults. This baseline config keeps Biome
as a security/correctness net WITHOUT forcing a wholesale reformat
of the JS surface in this PR. The formatter is disabled and the
broad `recommended` rule pack is off. A follow-up PR can tighten:
2. Enable `recommended: true` and fix the diffs incrementally.
3. Re-enable individual rules from suspicious / complexity sets.
